Review the code of the target named at the end (a file, folder or module) as it is now, not as a diff. If no target is named, review the main package of the repository.

Look for bugs, unhandled errors, unclear or duplicated code, and missing tests. If your instructions list check commands, run the ones that cover the target and include their results.

Do not modify anything. Reply in Markdown: concrete problems, most serious first, each with the file path and line number and why it matters, or say that you found none.
